title: Sharp minimum matrix rank six for the fixed-resolvent limit space
statement: Over every field, the explicitly defined fixed-resolvent limiting matrix space W has dimension 112 and minimum nonzero matrix rank exactly six. Its difficult 31-dimensional outer block admits 31 successive triangular six-by-six minor identities with unit diagonal factors and unit substitutions. Every two-sided compression with total rank-loss budget at most five is injective on W. If the 110-by-112 and 112-by-110 compression factors both have rank 109 and kill a nonzero X in W, then rank X = 6, ker X is contained in im C, X(im C) = ker P, im C = X^-1(ker P), and ker P lies in the final 28-dimensional source layer.
dependencies: Maintained literal cyclic convolution source and unimodular source unit, pinned in sources.json

limitations: Ordinary matrix rank, not tensor slice rank. No classification of all rank-six matrices, arbitrary singular degeneration, independent review, formalization, or smaller exponent. The narrow target application is superseded by the concurrent regular-long-leg theorem.
